graphics.observable: A labeled multicolor dashboard is presented every paint.

font.observable: The dashboard title, status labels, model, and counters render as text.

system.observable: SYSTEM changes to PASS and displays the PHONEMODEL property.

memory.observable: MEMORY changes to PASS only after zero-fill and pointer resolution checks.

timer.observable: TIMER changes from WAIT to PASS and its count advances.

input.observable: INPUT changes from WAIT to PASS and displays the last key value.

audio.observable: A generated one-second SMAF phrase plays and AUDIO changes to PASS.

storage.reason: Method 0x190 is filesystem open in the pinned ARAM profile but database open in the pinned Wie runtime; a common wrapper would hide an unresolved ABI split.

backlight.reason: Method 0x578 is backlight in Wie but an observed private runtime initializer in the pinned ARAM profile.

vibration.reason: Method 0x4c1 is implemented by Wie but is not yet modeled by the pinned ARAM Raptor runtime.

font_metrics.reason: Font metric selector IDs are implemented by Wie but are not yet mapped by the pinned ARAM Raptor adapter; font acquisition and drawing are tested instead.
